messages:
zoe: Heads-up: DSAR received for acct: usr-3c9f asking full erasure (vectors, analytics exports, backups). Legal looped in.

matt: What stores do we need to hit? vecstore-eu, analytics-export-bucket, nightly backups in s3://redwood-archives/eu/, plus EBS snapshots for ml-nodepool-4.

backup-eng: Confirmed: archives replicate to eu-west-1 and monthly vaults in Glacier Deep Archive. EBS snapshots are incremental; the backup-controller supports tombstone tagging but full chain cleanup takes ~5 days.

nina-legal: Identity verified. We expect deletion proof within 30 days; operational target 72h for live data. If any holds block deletion, legal must be notified immediately for exception filing.

sec-bot: KMS note: do NOT schedule CMK deletion. Flow: delete objects, tag records erased, emit signed deletion manifest referencing kms_key_id. Keep key for audit.

zoe: Ops proposal: create dsar-session role with scoped s3:DeleteObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-archives/eu/usr-3c9f/* and ec2:DeleteSnapshot where tag:subject=usr-3c9f. Short TTL tokens + session tag request_id required.

matt: Also need to scan analytics exports for hashed identifiers; may require analytics-team assist. Will open ticket ANALYTICS-512.

infra-bot: Created INFRA-9401 for dsar-session role and ANALYTICS-512 for exports.

backup-eng: We'll run vector deletes, then queue cross-region S3 deletions and Glacier jobs. EBS chain-sweep will be scheduled and we will document expected 5-day window.

nina-legal: If the 5-day EBS window is unavoidable, legal will accept a documented retention-exception with timeline and justification. Provide manifest and hashes for deleted objects.

zoe: Action items: 1) INFRA-9401 draft policy (infra) 2) analytics export search (matt) 3) backup-controller chain-sweep plan + timelines (backup-eng) 4) security manifest schema + signed upload path (sec-bot) 5) legal to prepare exception template if needed (nina-legal). I'll update DSAR-2025-331 with progress.

sec-bot: Reminder: audit log must contain actor, assumed_role_arn, request_id, resources_deleted[], kms_key_id, pre_delete_digest, post_delete_digest, and signed timestamp. Store in s3://redwood-audit/dsar/ with immutability flags.

zoe: Thanks. Executing live-store deletes now; will post manifest when done.
